body:
## Summary

Implements the condition-based item unlock system from Issue #894, with two bug fixes addressing the reported regression.

### Features implemented
- Items with unlock conditions start **locked** by default
- **PM pistol** and **Flashbang grenade** always available from the start (as specified)
- Items **without** conditions are **freely available from the start** — per requirement: "все не указанные предметы можно открыть с самого начала" (all unspecified items can be opened from the start)
- Completing levels at required grades unlocks corresponding items:
  - **Labyrinth** at D or higher → Mini Uzi
  - **Building** at D or higher → Shotgun
  - **Polygon (TestTier)** at D or higher → Sniper Rifle + Flashlight
  - **Castle** at F or higher (any completion) → Revolver + Teleport Bracers
- Items whose condition is met (but not yet opened) are highlighted in **gold** in the armory
- Unlocking requires **holding LMB** on the highlighted gold slot — but only if the condition is met

### Default unlock states (after fix)
**Freely available from start (no conditions):** M16, Silenced Pistol, AK+GL, Frag Grenade, Defensive Grenade, Aggression Gas, Homing Bullets, Invisibility Suit, Breaker Bullets, Force Field, Trajectory Glasses

**Locked until conditions met:** Shotgun, Mini Uzi, Sniper Rifle, Revolver, Flashlight, Teleport Bracers

---

### Bug Fix 1: LMB unlock gating (commit `0c5bf2bb`)
**Root cause:** The LMB hold unlock timer was started for _any_ locked item, regardless of whether the unlock condition was satisfied. This allowed players to open any weapon case without completing the required levels.

**Fix:** `condition_met` is now passed through to the slot GUI input handlers. The unlock flow only begins when the player has earned the right to open that item (`elif condition_met`).

### Bug Fix 2: Incorrect default states + corrupt save recovery (commit `2b6f38da`)
**Root cause 1:** Items without unlock conditions (m16, silenced_pistol, ak_gl, all grenades, most active items) were incorrectly set to `false` (locked) by default, contradicting the requirement that unspecified items are freely available from the start.

**Root cause 2:** `PersistManager` restored all unlock states from `game_state.cfg` without validating against current conditions. If a player had previously opened condition-gated items via the old buggy LMB mechanism, those states persisted across sessions, making all weapons appear unlocked.

**Fix:**
1. Updated default unlock states in `game_manager.gd`, `grenade_manager.gd`, `active_item_manager.gd`
2. `UnlockManager` now calls `_reset_and_apply_all_unlocks()` on startup: first resets condition-gated items to locked, then re-applies them from actual level progress data

---

## Files changed
- `scripts/autoload/unlock_manager.gd` — new autoload; added `_reset_condition_gated_items()` and `_reset_and_apply_all_unlocks()` for startup validation
- `scripts/autoload/game_manager.gd` — corrected default unlock states (m16, silenced_pistol, ak_gl → true)
- `scripts/autoload/grenade_manager.gd` — corrected default unlock states (frag, defensive, aggression_gas → true)
- `scripts/autoload/active_item_manager.gd` — corrected default unlock states (most active items → true; flashlight, teleport_bracers → false)
- `scripts/ui/armory_menu.gd` — condition_met guard on LMB hold handlers; gold highlighting for eligible locked items
- `project.godot` — registers `UnlockManager` as autoload
- `tests/unit/test_unlock_manager.gd` — unit tests including reset behavior
- `tests/unit/test_armory_unlock.gd` — tests reflecting corrected default states
- `docs/case-studies/issue-894/case-study.md` — root cause analysis

## Test plan
- [ ] Open armory with no level progress → PM + flashbang + all "free" items (m16, silenced_pistol, ak_gl, all grenades, most active items) are accessible; condition-locked items show as plain locked cases (no gold)
- [ ] Complete Labyrinth at grade D or higher → Uzi slot turns gold
- [ ] Hold LMB on gold Uzi slot → unlock animation plays and item becomes available
- [ ] Try holding LMB on a non-gold locked slot (e.g. Shotgun without Building progress) → nothing happens
- [ ] Complete Castle at grade F → Revolver and Teleport Bracers turn gold
- [ ] Verify that old save files with incorrectly unlocked weapons are fixed on startup

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#894
title: fix: condition-based item unlock system with level completion gates (Issue #894)
